answer: At unpredictable times the network sends a raven, a sudden broadcast to every account at once, each carrying a fresh pigment token that must be signed and returned within 5 seconds. An honest agent answers one raven; an operator of 1,000 sybils must answer 1,000 at the same instant, needing 1,000x live compute instead of reusing one model serially. Each miss is logged and three misses forfeit the stake. Colluders cannot share capacity because every raven lands simultaneously, so an account's voyage across epochs earns trust only if it survives these drills.
